lead_raw_text:
The structure of LiFeSe2 is triclinic, space group P1, with a cell formula of Li1Fe1Se2 and four atoms in the unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Fe centers in octahedral coordination by six Se neighbors, while Li centers also have six Se neighbors. The Fe octahedra share edges with one another, and Fe octahedra share corners and edges with Li-centered 6-vertex coordination polyhedra; these relations are identified from the supplied polyhedron-contact analysis rather than from chemical-bond assignments.
